items.exampleEn: Mistakes on stage can embarrass even famous singers.
items.exampleZh: 舞台上的失誤連知名歌手都會覺得難堪。

items.exampleEn: My dad has a stressful job at a big bank.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸在一家大銀行做壓力很大的工作。

items.exampleEn: The nurse greeted us with a cheerful hello.
items.exampleZh: 護理師開朗地跟我們打招呼。

items.exampleEn: We heard giggles from the back of the classroom.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到教室後面傳來咯咯的笑聲。

items.exampleEn: It was selfish of him to take the best seat.
items.exampleZh: 他搶了最好的座位，真是太自私了。
價格出乎意料地上漲了。

items.exampleEn: The stubborn child refused to go to bed.
items.exampleZh: 那個固執的孩子不肯上床睡覺。

items.exampleEn: Her kindness made everyone love her.
items.exampleZh: 她的善良讓大家都喜歡她。

items.audioEn: My sister is so stubborn. She won't wear a coat, even in the snow.
items.audioZh: 我的姊妹好固執，就算下雪也不肯穿外套。
items.questionZh: 說話者的姊妹有什麼個性？
options: She is kind to everyone she meets
She doesn't change her mind easily

items.sentenceEn: Her cheerful smile made my day.
items.sentenceZh: 她開朗的笑容讓我一整天都很開心。

items.sentenceEn: Moving to a new city can be stressful.
items.sentenceZh: 搬到新城市可能會讓人壓力很大。

items.stemEn: It's ____ to park in two spaces when the parking lot is full.
items.stemZh: 停車場都滿了還一車占兩格，真是自私。

items.stemEn: Please don't ____ me by telling everyone my secret.
items.stemZh: 請不要把我的秘密告訴大家，讓我難堪。

items.passageEn: Last month was a stressful time for me because of exams. My best friend Nora is a cheerful girl who always makes me laugh. One evening, she arrived at my house unexpectedly with a cake. My little brother wanted to eat all of it, but my mom said that would be selfish. Nora and I studied together, and our giggles filled the room. My dad tried to embarrass me by telling her funny stories about me as a baby. It was a little awkward, but we all laughed. I'm a bit stubborn, so I didn't want to stop studying, but Nora made me take a break. I'll never forget her kindness.
items.passageZh: 上個月因為考試，對我來說是壓力很大的一段時間。我最好的朋友 Nora 是個開朗的女生，總是能逗我笑。有一天傍晚，她出乎意料地帶著一個蛋糕來我家。我弟弟想把蛋糕全吃掉，但媽媽說那樣太自私了。Nora 和我一起讀書，房間裡充滿了我們咯咯的笑聲。爸爸想讓我難堪，跟她講我還是嬰兒時的好笑故事。有點尷尬，但我們都笑了。我有點固執，不想停下來休息，但 Nora 硬是要我休息一下。我永遠不會忘記她的善良。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸做了什麼讓作者難堪？
options: 在客廳大聲唱作者最喜歡的歌
把作者的日記拿給 Nora 看
講作者嬰兒時的好笑故事

questions.questionZh: 為什麼作者不想停下來休息？
options: 因為 Nora 一直在旁邊說話
因為明天一早就要考最難的科目
因為作者的個性有點固執

items.promptZh: 他太固執了，不肯承認錯誤。
referenceEn: He is too stubborn to admit his mistake.
He is so stubborn that he won't admit his mistake.
rubricZh: stubborn 表示「固執的」，例如 too stubborn to… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 這間教室漆成明亮的黃色，看起來很愉快。
referenceEn: The classroom is painted bright yellow, so it looks cheerful.
Painted in bright yellow, the classroom looks very cheerful.
rubricZh: 用 cheerful 表示「令人愉快的；明亮的」
